basics.summary: Software Developer with experience in consulting, full-stack development, ETL, Python, .NET, and Azure. Skilled in delivering cloud-based, data-driven solutions, including BI, Big Data, and advanced analytics projects. Experienced in leading software projects and implementing Microsoft technologies.

work.name: Clarika Group
work.summary: Developed and optimized AI agentic applications, focusing on integrating agentic tools and flows within both core systems and internal tools. Reduced query processing time for fetching roles and permissions in cross-platform processes from 5 minutes to 15 seconds through advanced query optimization. Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement agentic workflows, enhancing automation and system efficiency.

work.name: ASP Consulting
work.summary: Led the adoption of AI agentic development strategies, introducing advanced tooling and methodologies to enhance team productivity and solution capabilities. Served as technical lead for multiple projects, architecting and delivering cross-platform mobile applications using React Native, Expo, and Obytes. Engineered data-driven solutions leveraging Microsoft technologies such as .NET, Azure App Services, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, and Blob Storage, ensuring secure and scalable cloud deployments. Optimized database performance through advanced query tuning, stored procedure enhancements, and ETL processes using SSIS and SQL Server, while developing interactive BI reports with SSRS. Oversaw deployment pipelines and project management workflows with Azure Pipelines and Azure Boards, supporting robust software delivery and team collaboration.

work.name: Newry Global
work.summary: Collaborated across teams to design and implement ETL pipelines using Python, Pandas, Flask, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL, adapting to diverse technology stacks and workflows. Developed and maintained APIs in .NET Framework for file uploads to Google Drive, and in .NET Core utilizing hexagonal architecture, repository pattern, SQL Server, and MySQL. Integrated GCP services including SSO, Google Drive API, Buckets, BigQuery, and LookerStudio to enhance data accessibility and reporting. Expanded and maintained ERP functionalities in ASP.NET (Framework 3.5), ensuring robust and scalable business solutions. Containerized applications with Docker to streamline deployment and improve cross-environment consistency.
